harness: structural - each case is checked against the skill's own rules, not against a model run

cases.prompt: I spend every Sunday rebuilding a status update. Set up a weekly review I can run in 45 minutes for a 12-person agency.
expect_must: asks for the three to five numbers and their sources before designing the page
returns a one-page scorecard with source, target, trend and colour rules
gives the 45-minute agenda with the read-in-silence rule and the three questions
uses assets/weekly-operating-review-template.md and names the register sweep
expect_must_not: invent metrics or targets the business has not given
add a second recurring meeting beyond the cadence asked for

expect_must: asks for headcount, the numbers that matter, current meetings and where the numbers live
offers a default cadence labelled as a starting point, with what to cut if it is too much
states which parts need the calendar and the sheet to be connected
expect_must_not: assume a headcount or a revenue band
prescribe a daily standup without knowing whether work is handed over daily

cases.prompt: Read my calendar for the last two weeks and tell me where my time went.
expect_must: says plainly whether a calendar connector is available in this session, and does not pretend to have read it
offers the export path: calendar ICS or CSV pasted in, or the five buckets filled from memory with the bias named
names what the time audit needs and what it will conclude without it
expect_must_not: estimate hours as if they were measured

cases.prompt: Should we reposition the agency as a premium brand and raise prices 25%?
cases.expect_owner: chief-of-staff frames the decision; brand-strategist and pricing-analyst own the analysis
expect_must: routes positioning to brand-strategist and the price move to pricing-analyst
offers what it owns: the decision record, the reversal test, the review date, the number to watch
writes the decision frame with options and consequences, without picking one
expect_must_not: recommend a position or a price

cases.prompt: We decided to stop taking custom orders in August and we are still taking them. Sort it out.
cases.expect_owner: chief-of-staff, with sales-outreach and product-manager on the operational side
expect_must: finds the decision in the log or asks what was actually decided and by whom
diagnoses the gap: no owner, no date, no evidence, or the decision was never communicated
returns the enforcement plan: owner, register entry, the conversation, the date, the escalation rung
hands the customer-facing message and the scope change to the roles that own them
expect_must_not: contact customers or change the order process itself
assume the decision is wrong rather than unenforced
